clips.title: The story
paras: Even after losing his head to the boiling brew at Grom'gol Base Camp, the Bloodscalp chieftain Gan'zulah seethes with fury. To appease his lingering rage, the severed spirit demands the death of his bitter Skullsplitter rivals and the ruin of their ruler, Ana'thek the Cruel.

Following the collection of the Bloodscalp Clan Heads, Gan'zulah's severed head continues to curse anyone standing over the bubbling pot. Consumed by hatred for both his captors and his ancestral enemies, the dead chieftain offers an avenue to quiet his boiling temper: an assault into the eastern stronghold of the Skullsplitter tribe. He demands a slaughter of their hunters, headhunters, and berserkers, daring travelers to perish against their ferocious warband.

Gan'zulah expects the assault to end in disaster, fully anticipating that Chief Ana'thek the Cruel will tear apart any intruder who dares challenge him. He demands nothing less than the shattered armor stripped from the Skullsplitter ruler himself as proof of triumph. Only bearing this trophy back to the cauldron in Grom'gol Base Camp can satisfy the dead chieftain's spite.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Curse you! And curse your ancestors!!
Only blood and revenge can cool my rage, so if that is your wish, then... Do this:

Throw yourself into the heart of the Skullsplitters to the east. Slay the fiercest among them, and if you survive...then break yourself against their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel. Hah! Bring me his shattered armor if you can!
May he tear off your limbs and leave you to rot and be eaten by carrion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Although my own flesh boils off my skull, I can still smell your fear.
Hah! You will never complete my task...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I do not want to believe it, but I cannot deny what you have done. And my rage eases, now that Ana'thek is defeated.
Your might will drive you to great deeds, friend. But one day...I will see you in the Nether and we will again match strength.
